variants.name: Thin modular boards
variants.construction: Six rigid copper layers at 18um, separate two-layer 24um flex; retained connectors and packages. Custom stackup requires approval.
variants.relative_cost: Lowest candidate complexity; still custom thin six-layer assembly.

variants.name: Custom ultrathin rigid-flex
variants.construction: Six 12um rigid copper layers, integrated two-layer 12um flex. Aspirational stackup, no matching manufacturer construction verified.
variants.relative_cost: Premium custom construction, dense assembly and microvia development.
